methods: Independently read git ls-remote for all fork refs/heads/* and refs/pull/*/head, and all upstream refs/heads/*.
Matched each observed head against the freshly fetched origin, pull and upstream remote-tracking ref.
Checked commit-object presence and git merge-base --is-ancestor against the exact comparison checkpoint for every unique head.

Accepted only exact unchanged SHA values for historical equivalents freshly reverified in incoming-reconciliation.json; confirmed their integrated equivalent commits remain ancestors where applicable.
Compared all observed names and SHAs against the complete initial inventory and incoming reconciliation record; performed no merges or source mutations in this final check.
github_actions: No Actions or commit-status endpoints queried; no CI waiting.
scope: Bounded remote snapshot at the listed observation times, before the final implementation checkpoint. Later external updates require a new bounded observation. Working-tree edits are outside the ancestry comparison.
